reasons: Covers both the hero and control journeys.
Uses the real services rather than stand-ins.
Depends on the seeded demo documents being present.

terms.meaning: a test that runs the whole path a user would take through the app
sample starting data loaded into storage so the demo has something to show
an ordered list of events that happened to a case
a saved draft summary prepared for a reviewer

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports the services the journey touches
sections.what: Brings in the case, document, guidance, review packet, timeline and verification services, plus the test tools.
sections.why: Likely reason: the test calls the real services directly, not fake versions of them.

sections.name: judge-ready synthetic journeys
sections.title: Walks the hero and control journeys
sections.what: Runs the hero case from documents through verification, guidance, a review packet and a timeline, then checks the two expected potential issues and their source documents. It then runs the control case and checks it has no false hero discrepancies.
sections.why: Likely reason: confirms the story the demo tells holds from start to finish, and that the control case stays clean.
sections.watch_out: The expected source document lists are fixed, so renaming a seed document ID breaks the test.

summary: End-to-end style test that walks the hero case through the full flow and checks the control case does not show false discrepancies.
purpose: Proves the demo story works as a whole: documents, verification, guidance, review packet and timeline all agree with each other.
why: Likely reason: a reviewer sees the full journey, so one test checks that the whole path works together.
how: The first test seeds documents, loads the hero case, runs verification, builds guidance, creates a review packet for the area issue and builds a timeline, then checks each result. The second test runs verification on the control case and checks that area passes and family context shows insufficient evidence.
inputs: No direct inputs; it uses the demo case identifiers.
outputs: A pass or fail result for each test.
risks: A failure in any shared service makes this test fail, so the cause may lie in a different file than the one that seems to break.
debug: Run this file alone and read which expectation fails. The failing check names the service to open first.
